summary: Jace wakes in a bamboo grove on an island with no memory of how he arrived or of his own name.
quote: He did not know how he had gotten here. He did not know his own name.

summary: Jace instinctively tries to planeswalk away, but a massive force yanks him back and a circle-and-triangle sigil appears above him.
quote: only to feel himself yanked backward, pulled by some massive force back through whatever metaphysical door he had begun to walk through

summary: Jace finds deliberate, surgical scars on his right forearm and back.
quote: A scar ran in a perfect line down his right forearm.

summary: A fire Jace wills into being gives no heat and vanishes in blue light; he concludes he has gone insane.
quote: The man solemnly concluded that he had gone insane.

summary: Jace sees visions of people from his forgotten past, among them a woman in violet who makes him anxious.
quote: he would sometimes see a woman in violet on the edge of his field of vision

summary: Jace realizes his visions are illusions he casts himself and that he is a mage.
quote: I'm not hallucinating—I've been creating illusions!

summary: An illusion of a raven-haired woman in violet tells Jace he was never a leader or a detective, only a frightened child playing pretend.
quote: you were a frightened child playing pretend

summary: Jace takes control of his magic, ending his involuntary illusions, and resolves to become whoever he wants to be.
quote: Whoever I was is irrelevant, for I will become whoever I want to become.

summary: Jace builds a raft and sails away from Useless Island.
quote: Useless Island disappeared over the horizon, and infinite azure stretched out in front of him.

summary: A storm wrecks Jace's raft and he washes up on a barren rock covered in seabirds.
quote: Exhausted and defeated, the man kicked himself over toward his new home.

summary: Descending into his own mind, Jace finds his spark, the one part of himself his memory loss did not take.
quote: a shining light embedded in the well of his mind

summary: Jace tries to planeswalk again and is pulled back once more by the same sigil.
quote: Once again, he felt himself violently tugged backward

summary: The ship the Belligerent finds Jace; its gorgon captain, Vraska, threatens him, then sees the state he is in and recognizes him by name.
quote: Jace, what the hell happened to you?
